title: Mermaids Grotto | KEY.co
description_expanded: Mermaids Grotto, located in the idyllic Seacrest Beach, FL, offers a luxurious beachside retreat with all the comforts of home. This charming three-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bathroom vacation home features an expansive screened-in deck perfect for relaxing evenings, a spacious living area with a 65" Smart TV, and a fully equipped kitchen with a breakfast bar for casual dining. Each bedroom boasts modern conveniences, with the two king bedrooms featuring en suite bathrooms and 55" TVs. The third bedroom, complete with a full bed and 43" TV, along with a cozy bunk area and a sleeper sofa in the living area, ensures ample space for families to unwind. Magnolia Cottages by the Sea, a new addition to the famed 30A, perfectly blends coastal charm with modern amenities. Guests at Mermaids Grotto will enjoy easy beach access at Gulf Lakes and can unwind in the community's resort-style pool set against a backdrop of natural wooded beauty. The thoughtful design of Magnolia Cottages enhances relaxation and rejuvenation, offering a tranquil escape from the everyday hustle. Whether basking in the sun on the pristine beaches or enjoying the serene surroundings, Mermaids Grotto promises an unforgettable family vacation in a picturesque coastal haven.
